The primary focuses of the Crystal Hollows are mining [[Gemstones]] and collecting [[Gemstone Crystals]] to complete the [[Crystal Nucleus]]. {{ZoneText|Mine to your heart's content!|Mine new ores and fight new enemies!|Discover Crystals to earn rewards and forge Perfect Gems!}} == Overview == The '''Crystal Hollows''' consists of a large series of tunnels made of {{Item|Hard Stone}}, with veins of [[Gemstones]] and randomly-generated structures scattered throughout the caves. The tunnels themselves remain the same across lobbies, but the locations of structures will always be different across different servers. At the center of the '''Crystal Hollows''' houses the {{Zone|Crystal Nucleus}}, where [[Gemstone Crystals]] can be placed. Talking to {{NPCSprite|Gwendolyn}} allows you to purchase a pass to the '''Crystal Hollows''' for {{Green|6h}} for {{c|10k}}: you gain permanent, unrestricted access to the '''Crystal Hollows''' after helping {{NPCSprite|Dulin}}. === Mining === While inside the Crystal Hollows, '''broken ores and blocks are not replaced with bedrock.''' Instead, they will physically be broken be replaced with air, similar to vanilla ''Minecraft''. Blocks can be broken everywhere except the {{Zone|Crystal Nucleus}} and in specific structures: {{Item|Torch}}es, {{Item|Ladder}}s, {{Item|Hard Stone}}, and {{Item|Cobblestone}}, alongside [[Granite]], [[Andesite]], and their Polished Variants can also be placed. {{Item|Stone}} is replaced by {{Item|Hard Stone}} inside the '''Crystal Hollows''', which has a higher {{Stat|bp}} and a unique Collection. [[Gemstone]]s, {{Item|Mithril}}, and most Ores can spawn inside the Crystal Hollows. Ores that require a Furnace to be smelted into an ingot, such as {{Item|Iron Ore}} and {{Item|Gold Ore}}, do not require {{Ench|Smelting Touch}} or a Furnace to be converted to an ingot. Yields from most vanilla ores are increased within the Crystal Hollows. {| class="wikitable" |+Ore Yields !Icon !Ore !Base Yield |- |{{Slot|Coal Ore}} |Coal Ore |{{Item|Coal|amount=4-6}} |- |{{Slot|Lapis Lazuli Ore}} |Lapis Lazuli Ore |{{Item|Lapis Lazuli|amount=9-14}} |- |{{Slot|Redstone Ore}} |Redstone Ore |{{Item|Redstone Dust|amount=9-14}} |- |{{Slot|Emerald Ore}} |Emerald Ore |{{Item|Emerald|amount=4-6}} |- |{{Slot|Diamond Ore}} |Diamond Ore |{{Item|Diamond|amount=4-6}} |} == Zones == There are {{Green|5}} main locations in the '''Crystal Hollows''', being the {{Zone|Jungle}}, {{Zone|Mithril Deposits}}, {{Zone|Precursor Remnants}}, {{Zone|Goblin Holdout}}, and {{Zone|Magma Fields}}. These correspond to their respective [[Gemstones|Gemstone]], that being [[File:Rough Amethyst Gemstone.png|21px|link=Gemstones]] [[Gemstones|Amethyst]], [[File:Rough Jade Gemstone.png|21px|link=Gemstones]] [[Gemstones|Jade]], [[File:Rough Sapphire Gemstone.png|21px|link=Gemstones]] [[Gemstones|Sapphire]], [[File:Rough Amber Gemstone.png|21px|link=Gemstones]] [[Gemstones|Amber]], and [[File:Rough Topaz Gemstone.png|21px|link=Gemstones]] [[Gemstones|Topaz]]. [[File:Rough Ruby Gemstone.png|21px|link=Gemstones]] [[Gemstones|Ruby]] can also be found in the '''Crystal Hollows''' and can be found everywhere. Additionally, {{Green|3}} {{Zone|Fairy Grotto}}s spawn in random locations throughout the Crystal Hollows: [[File:Rough Jasper Gemstone.png|21px|link=Gemstones]] [[Gemstones|Jasper]] can be mined there. Each primary location has a sub-location, where its respective '''[[Gemstone Crystals|Gemstone Crystal]]''' can be obtained. * The {{Zone|Jungle}} contains the {{Zone|Jungle Temple}}, where a {{Item|Jungle Key}} must be given to access a series of parkour with the {{Item|Amethyst Crystal}} at the end; * The {{Zone|Mithril Deposits}} contains the {{Zone|Mines of Divan}}, where a {{Item|Metal Detector}} must be used to find and return [[Scavenged Items]], with the {{Item|Jade Crystal}} being rewarded at the end; * The {{Zone|Precursor Remnants}} contains the {{Zone|Lost Precursor City}}, where all {{Green|6}} [[Professor Robot|Automaton Parts]] or a {{Item|Precursor Apparatus}} must be given to access the {{Item|Sapphire Crystal}}; * The {{Zone|Goblin Holdout}} contains the {{Zone|Goblin Queen's Den}}, where any variant of [[Goblin Egg]] must be given to {{NPCSprite|King Yolkar}} the {{Item|Amber Crystal}} without being caught; * The {{Zone|Magma Fields}} contains {{Zone|Khazad-dûm}}, where {{MobSprite|Bal}} must be defeated to claim the {{Item|Topaz Crystal}}. '''Gemstone Crystals''' can be placed in the {{Zone|Crystal Nucleus}} to or used to forge '''Perfect Gemstones'''. You can see the status of Gemstone Crystals in the tablist: a Crystal can either be {{Red|'''Not Found'''}}, {{Yellow|'''Not Placed'''}}, or {{Green|'''Placed'''}}. A Gemstone Crystal must be found but {{Yellow|'''Not Placed'''}} to be used in the Forge to forge an its respective Perfect Gemstone. {{:Locations/Crystal Hollows}} == Treasure Chests == '''Treasure Chests''' exist in {{green|2}} types : '''Dug Chests''' and '''Structure Chests'''. They are found exclusively in the '''Crystal Hollows'''. They are the main way of gaining {{Gemstone Powder}}. {{Main|Treasure Chest}} ==Metal Detector Chests== '''Metal Detector Chests''' are exclusively found among the {{Item|Pure Gold}} coating the floor of the {{Zone|Mines of Divan}} using a {{Item|Metal Detector}}. They are relevant in obtaining the {{Item|Jade Crystal}}. {{Main|Metal Detector#Drops}} == Structures == {{Main|Crystal Hollows/Special Locations}} Each part of the Crystal Hollows has its own main special location, excluding [[Magma Fields]], which will almost always generate in every lobby: * The [[Jungle Temple]] generated in the [[Jungle]] * The [[Mines of Divan]] generated in the [[Mithril Deposits]] * The [[Goblin Queen's Den]] generated in the [[Goblin Holdout]] * The [[Lost Precursor City]] generated in the [[Precursor Remnants]] * 3 [[Fairy Grotto]]s generated anywhere within the Crystal Hollows Each of these structures house their respective [[Crystal Nucleus|Crystal]]. A special task must be completed to obtain the Crystal. [[Khazad-dûm]] is the one location that can spawn in any part of the Crystal Hollows, making it harder to find. There are also smaller structures which generate in random locations. Examples include: * A structure which resembles the [[Deep Caverns]], including the lift and the layered structure of the original Deep Caverns island * A dragon skull from the [[Spider's Den]] * A replica of the [[Dark Auction]] * A miniature version of [[The Forge]] including a working forge NPC * A copy of the pre-[[Hub]] overhaul [[Tavern]] A full list of Structures can be found at [[Crystal Hollows/Special Locations]]. Certain structures contain loot chests. Loot chests always generate in the same positions within the structures, similar to [[Dungeon Secrets]]. Loot Chests also generate the same items for every player, meaning if a player finds a chest with good loot such as a lot of Gemstone Powder or a Blue Goblin Egg, they can send the coordinates to chat to lead others to the chest. == NPCs == {{Location NPCs}} ==Game Messages== {{Outdated|section=y|Add other game messages relative to the Crystal Hollows.}} ==Tips== {{Text anchor|Day Count|}} {{For|a tutorial on reading the '''Day Count''' of a world on Java Edition 1.21.9 and above|Tutorial:Day Count}} {{For|a tutorial on navigating from the default {{zone|Jungle}} spawn location to the {{Zone|Crystal Nucleus}}|Tutorial:Navigation#Crystal Hollows}} == Trivia == * The life of a '''Crystal Hollows''' lobby is determined by the following rules: ** On '''Day {{green|0}}''' (1st day), the lobby opens to players; ** On '''Day {{green|19}}''' (20th day), the lobby becomes locked, preventing new players from entering. Henceforth, if there are '''less than {{green|4}} players''', then the lobby will start shutting down. ** On '''Day {{green|35}}''' (36th day), the lobby will forcefully start shutting down regardless of player count. * The '''Crystal Hollows''' are internally referred to as the '''Greater Mines''' in the SkyBlock API. * The '''Crystal Hollows''' are the only place {{Item|Dirt}}, {{Item|Andesite}}, {{Item|Diorite}}, and {{Item|Granite}} (and other blocks) can be mined, however, only {{Item|Dirt}} drops itself and all others drop {{Item|Hard Stone}} instead. * [[Ores]] within a few blocks of the {{Item|Bedrock}} border may not get auto-smelted without {{Ench|Smelting Touch}}. * Attempting to get into the '''Crystal Hollows''' using an {{Item|Ender Pearl}} will result in the player being teleported out with the following message, even if they do have a valid Crystal Hollows Pass: *:{{Dialogue|&eYou have been teleported out of the &5Crystal Hollows &ebecause you did not have a valid
